tldr: The US and Iran paused attacks, leading to the largest one-day decline in oil prices in two months and contributing to market optimism.
Nvidia and Microsoft, alongside IBM and others, launched the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop and share open-source AI security tools.
German officials have called for tighter extremism laws following a Berlin Pride attack, prompting questions about the suspect's prior status.

market.why: The S&P 500 saw a slight increase, possibly due to renewed market optimism following the pause in US-Iran attacks and investor pivoting towards high-quality megacap stocks amid AI adoption. The Nasdaq Composite, however, experienced a decline, potentially reflecting broader tech sector volatility ahead of major tech earnings and a rotation away from some tech stocks, despite the overall AI trade.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield slightly decreased. This could be attributed to easing inflation concerns following a significant plunge in oil prices, which occurred after the US and Iran paused attacks, reducing geopolitical tensions and the risk premium on oil.

vix.why: The VIX decreased marginally, likely reflecting a slight reduction in overall market volatility and investor uncertainty, driven by hopes for de-escalation in the US-Iran conflict which led to a plunge in oil prices.

tech.summary: Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX, and IBM have formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to create and share open-source AI security tools, addressing concerns about frontier model security.

Agentic AI, envisioned as software agents executing end-to-end business tasks across workflows, data, and systems, requires platforms with robust CPU capacity, resilient data access, policy-aware tool use, and memory management for enterprise adoption.

The development of artificial superintelligence may involve healthcare systems using multiple expert AI agents for tasks like symptom assessment and scheduling, which can exchange data but currently lack coordination.

world.summary: The United States and Iran have paused their attacks against each other, leading to a significant drop in oil prices and fostering hopes for de-escalation in the conflict.

German officials are advocating for stricter laws regarding known extremists following an attack at Berlin Pride, prompting public questions about why the suspected perpetrator was not already in custody.
Ukrainian President Zelensky has arrived in the United Kingdom for an upcoming meeting with the new Prime Minister, Andy Burnham, marking his first international visitor since taking office.
